primary_design_reference.status: Historical experimental BBRv1 design draft; not a current IETF standard.
primary_design_reference.interpretation: The bandwidth filter admits every network-limited sample, plus application-limited samples at least as high as its estimate. Startup growth compares the current congestion window with its target, while retaining the initial-delivery exception.

defects.finding: The original AND and strict-increase predicate excluded all application-limited samples and stopped lower eligible samples from aging the maximum.
defects.repair: Use non-app-limited OR sample>=estimate; retain the existing bounded ten-round filter.

defects.finding: The startup branch compared dimensionless cwnd_gain with target bytes rather than current cwnd bytes.
defects.repair: Compare current cwnd with target_window; preserve initial-delivery growth, full-bandwidth clamp, recovery and minimum-window behavior.

original_sustained_failure.observations: The graph20 sustained test failed its positive BBR model-rate assertion; one direction reported model rate0 with a congestion window of about7.77MiB. The assertion is unchanged and this run remains failed.

cases: Higher application-limited samples initialize and increase the estimate
Lower application-limited samples cannot lower or age the estimate
Lower network-limited samples age the maximum after its window
Equal application-limited samples refresh the maximum timestamp
Startup at target stops ACK-driven growth after initial delivery
Startup below target and initial-delivery exception retain intended growth
Full-pipe congestion window remains capped by its target
Application-limited delivery establishes a positive BBR model pacing rate

content.reference_status: Historical experimental BBRv1 design draft; not a current IETF standard

findings.finding: AND plus strict-increase-only filtering discards higher application-limited samples and prevents eligible lower samples aging the max filter.
findings.repair: Admit sample when non-app-limited OR bandwidth >= current estimate; max filter remains bounded ten-round window.

findings.finding: Startup growth compares dimensionless cwnd_gain with target bytes, so ordinary positive target grows even when current cwnd already meets target.
findings.repair: Compare current cwnd bytes with target bytes; preserve initial-delivery exception and full-bandwidth branch.

content.pacing_boundary: src/connection/pacing.rs uses 1.25*cwnd/smoothedRTT for token refill. BBR metrics.pacing_rate is a model diagnostic, not a direct pacer input. Positive model rate proves learning only; actual media and control behavior require separate sustained/runtime tests.

limits: The root review identifies BBR metrics.pacing_rate as a model diagnostic. The current transport pacer uses congestion window and smoothed RTT, so positive model rate alone does not prove paced output.
Fresh combined runtime sustained tests and decoded native/browser impairment profiles remain necessary.
Application queue64/76032-byte bounds,200ms stale discard, reliable-control assertions and all frozen media thresholds are unchanged.
